evidence_packet.evidence_text: Disney's High School Musical Sun 06 Sep 2026 - Sat 19 Sep 2026 Musicals Theatre West End Shows Matinee Dates Sun 06 Sep 2026 2:00PM Lyric Theatre Limited availability Sun 06 Sep 2026 7:00PM Lyric Theatre Tickets Tue 08 Sep 2026 7:00PM Lyric Theatre Tickets Wed 09 Sep 2026 2:00PM Hope Mill Theatre and Chris Harper Productions in association with Lowry are delighted to announce that Harry Judd will star in the final two shows of Disney’s HIGH SCHOOL MUSICAL at Lowry, Salford on Saturday 19 September 2026 before transferring to London’s Troubadour Wembley P Icon Jason Donovan * will play Coach Bolton and Disney royalty KayCee Stroh ( High School Musical Trilogy ) stars as Ms Darbus in Disney's HIGH SCHOOL MUSICAL . They join the previously announced Tobias Turley ( ITV’s Mamma Mia! I Have A Dream ), Leonor Correia ( Six ), Caitlin T Based on the hit Disney Channel Original Movie - join Troy, Gabriella and the students of East High as they navigate the highs and lows of first love, friendships, and self-discovery — all while juggling classes, basketball games, auditions and the expectations of their peers. Th Co-directed by Hope Mill Theatre founders Joseph Houston and William Whelton , with a book by David Simpatico and music adapted, arranged and produced by Bryan Louiselle , this is High School Musical like you’ve never seen it before Featuring all the hit songs from the original film, including Breaking Free, We’re All In This Together, Stick to the Status Quo, Get’cha Head in the Game and many more

evidence_packet.evidence_text: Wythenshawe Makers Market | Markets in Manchester - Pedddle search clock-o tags map-marker mail-forward calendar external-link twitter facebook caret-down caret-up caret-left caret-right envelope angle-double-left angle-double-right angle-double-up angle-double-down calendar-o instagram wheelchair automobile pinterest-p youtube bars arrow-right2 arrow-right arrow-left arrow-left2 shopping-basket user Pedddle Pin shop shopping-bag2 close Skip to content Details Favourite Address Wythenshawe Civic Centre Manchester M22 5RG Date First Saturday of the month Time 10:00am - 4:00pm Next Markets 5th Sep 2026, 3rd Oct 2026, 7th Nov 2026, 5th Dec 2026 Organiser The Makers Market Social Website themakersmarket.co.uk Accessibility Outdoor market. Parking We recommend arriving by public transport. Wythenshawe Tram stop is just a 2 minute walk from the market, as is Wythenshawe Bus Interchange. Cycle rack available at market. Facilities Wheelchair Accessible All Outdoor Dog Friendly Markets in Greater Manchester , Manchester , North West , The North Wythenshawe Makers Market takes place on the first Saturday of every month in the town centre of Wythenshawe, offering an abundance of the North West's finest makers, bakers and creators. Expect an array of art, craft, food, drink, coffee, music, street food, and all the classic Makers Market delights. Wythenshawe Makers Market is a great day out for everyone and is a family-focused event, so bring your friends, family and the dog! evidence_packet.evidence_text: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. It runs every Sunday from February right through to December, drawing over 300 sellers and thousands of bargain hunters each week. Sellers can arrive and set up from 6:00 AM, with buyers welcomed in from 7:00 AM. Entry costs just £1 per car for buyers. Pitches for sellers are £14 for a car, £20 for a van and £3 for a trailer, with regular and corner pitches available on request. Bring exact change to keep the queue moving, and call organiser Andrew on 07470784644 for more details. Expect hundreds of stalls across the concrete hardstanding pitches, so it goes ahead in most weather. On-site you'll find a 5-star catering service, doughnuts and coffee, ice cream and desserts, a meat auction, fresh fruit and veg, plants, and retro sweet stalls. The sale is dog-friendly, has male and female toilets, ample parking, and kids' rides and bouncy castles to keep little ones entertained.
